Name: Realistic Wildflower Grass for More Grass
Author: Squiver
Description:
A grass pack which adds a wide variety of grasses to every season, all based on real wildflowers and wild grasses from their respective seasons. Turn the grassy areas on your farm into a wild, lush meadow, teeming with lively color and diverse shapes!

From spring, dominated by fiddleheads, Spring Beauty, Forget-Me-Not and Anemone, to summer, dominated by deep green grasses, ferns, clover, Wild Thyme and more, to autumn with it's smattering of white and purple Asters above a sea of softly yellow and orange grasses, and finally to winter, with it's bare vestiges of plants barely protruding from the snow, cut by the occasional smattering of Snowdrop flowers.
--------------------------------------------------------
To install, you must first install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]More Grass[/url]. Afterwards, simply download and unzip the folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.

The default grass is disabled by default, but if you would like to enable it, simply open up the config.json inside the mod folder with Notepad (or compatible text editor) after the game has been started once with the mod installed, and change the word "false" to "true".

This pack, like all More Grass packs, is compatible with any other grass pack that uses the framework, so feel free to install as many as suits your fancy!
--------------------------------------------------------
All screenshots were taken with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4705]Stardew Foliage Redone - A Nature Toned Map Recolour[/url] as well as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color - Reshade[/url]﻿. Additionally, this pack was in part made to match my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5422]Seasonal Wildflowers[/url] pack, many of which can be seen in the various screenshots. I recommend installing it for an even more immersive seasonal experience!
